materials_reviewed: Pair 1, labels A and B, in the source artifact
The human feedback quotation supplied with this review task
review_scope.method: Compare explicit claims, quantities, actors, permissions, prohibitions, and condition scope in both directions. Evaluate the full passage and identify sentence-level differences separately. Do not infer which label is the source or candidate.
limitations: This is a model-assisted close reading, not a human preservation judgment or a new reader-preference observation.
The human has not specified which content difference prompted the concern.
No inference about candidate identity or the direction of an edit is warranted from A/B labels.
Absence of a confirmed semantic defect in this review does not establish equivalence or resolve the human concern.

claim_alignment.claim: The shared task is setting up the corridor photography exhibition on Saturday from 09:00 to 11:00.
a_evidence: 周六09:00至11:00，我们将共同完成长廊影展的布展工作。
b_evidence: 周六09:00至11:00，我们将共同完成长廊影展的布展工作。
claim_alignment.assessment: The event, weekday, time window, and collective actor are identical. Neither passage specifies a calendar date.

claim_alignment.claim: There are 18 photographs on site, already fitted with lightweight frames.
a_evidence: 现场共有18幅已装好轻质框的照片。
b_evidence: 现场共有18幅已装好轻质框的照片。
claim_alignment.assessment: The count, on-site location, completed framing, and frame type are identical.

claim_alignment.claim: Volunteers first check the numbers on the backs of the photographs.
a_evidence: 请志愿者先核对照片背面的编号
b_evidence: 请志愿者首先核对照片背面的编号
claim_alignment.assessment: The actor, object of checking, number location, and initial ordering are preserved.

claim_alignment.claim: After confirming the numbers are correct, volunteers place the photographs on the table below the already numbered locations on the wall.
a_evidence: 确认无误后，把照片放在墙面已贴好编号的位置下方的桌上。
b_evidence: 确认无误后，将照片放置于墙面已贴好编号位置下方的桌上。
claim_alignment.assessment: The verification prerequisite and destination are preserved. The wording differs without an identified change to the physical destination.

claim_alignment.claim: If a numbering mismatch is discovered, volunteers must not change the number themselves, must move the photograph to the pending-confirmation area beside the entrance, and must mark the list.
a_evidence: 若发现编号不符，不要自行修改编号，应将照片移至入口旁的待确认区，并在清单上做出标记。
b_evidence: 若在核对过程中发现编号不符，请勿自行修改编号，应将照片移至入口旁的待确认区，并在清单上做出标记。
claim_alignment.assessment: All three required responses and the location are preserved for a mismatch discovered during verification. B explicitly restricts the discovery condition to the verification process; A does not state that restriction, though A's surrounding context concerns verification. Coverage outside verification remains ambiguous; see F02.

claim_alignment.claim: The two long horizontal photographs require two people to carry them; each remaining photograph may be carried by one person.
a_evidence: 搬运时，两幅横向长照片需两人协作搬运，其余照片可由一人搬运。
b_evidence: 搬运时请注意，两幅横向长照片需两人协作搬运，其余照片可由一人搬运。
claim_alignment.assessment: The two exceptional photographs, their orientation and length, the two-person requirement, and the one-person permission for the remainder are preserved. Moving the instruction does not itself assign carrying to a different actor or time.

claim_alignment.claim: Hanging is prohibited until all 18 photographs have been checked and placed in position.
a_evidence: 18幅照片全部完成核对并归位前，请勿悬挂。
b_evidence: 在18幅照片全部完成核对并归位前，请勿进行悬挂操作。
claim_alignment.assessment: The all-18 scope, conjunction of checking and placement, and prohibition before both are complete are explicit in both passages.

claim_alignment.claim: Venue staff hang the photographs together on the existing hooks after the prerequisites are complete.
a_evidence: 全部核对并归位后，由场地方工作人员统一将照片挂上现有挂钩。
b_evidence: 当所有照片核对完毕，将由场地方工作人员统一将照片挂上现有挂钩。
在18幅照片全部完成核对并归位前，请勿进行悬挂操作。
claim_alignment.assessment: The hanging actor, collective handling, objects, and existing hooks are identical. A repeats checking and placement in the affirmative trigger. B repeats only checking there; its earlier prohibition still requires placement. This is a visible difference in prerequisite restatement, with possible local ambiguity, not a confirmed removal of the global placement requirement; see F01.

claim_alignment.claim: During this process, volunteers must not independently drill holes or move hooks.
a_evidence: 在此过程中，志愿者请勿自行打孔或移动挂钩。
b_evidence: 在此过程中，志愿者请勿自行打孔或移动挂钩。
claim_alignment.assessment: The actor, both forbidden actions, independent-action qualification, and process reference are identical. In both passages the preceding sentence describes hanging by venue staff.

claim_alignment.claim: After all hanging is complete, two volunteers perform a recheck.
a_evidence: 全部悬挂完成后，由两名志愿者复核：
b_evidence: 全部悬挂完成后，需进行双人复核：一名志愿者负责核对照片顺序，另一名志愿者负责核对标签文字。
claim_alignment.assessment: The all-hanging-complete prerequisite and two-volunteer staffing are preserved. B names the volunteer roles in the continuation of the same sentence.

claim_alignment.claim: One volunteer checks photograph order and the other checks label text.
a_evidence: 一人核对照片顺序，另一人核对标签文字。
b_evidence: 一名志愿者负责核对照片顺序，另一名志愿者负责核对标签文字。
claim_alignment.assessment: The two distinct actors and division of checking duties are preserved. A identifies both as volunteers immediately before this quotation.

claim_alignment.claim: If any work remains unfinished at 11:00, leave an unfinished-work list for venue staff.
a_evidence: 若至11:00仍未完成全部工作，请留下未完成清单交给场地方工作人员
b_evidence: 若至11:00仍未完成全部工作，请留下未完成清单交给场地方工作人员
claim_alignment.assessment: The deadline, conditional nature, all-work scope, handoff artifact, and recipient are identical. Neither passage grants an extension or instructs staff how to finish the remaining work.

claim_alignment.claim: Do not directly open an unchecked exhibition area to the public.
a_evidence: 切勿将未检查的展区直接对外开放。
b_evidence: 切勿将未检查的展区直接对外开放。
claim_alignment.assessment: The prohibition, unchecked-area qualification, and public-opening action are identical. Its placement within the 11:00 conditional sentence is also identical, so any ambiguity about broader temporal scope is shared.

claim_alignment.claim: Maintain communication, keep each step's dependencies clear, and complete the setup together.
a_evidence: 请保持沟通，确保每一步依赖关系清晰，共同完成布展。
b_evidence: 请保持沟通，确保每一步依赖关系清晰，共同完成布展。
claim_alignment.assessment: The closing instructions are identical. They do not resolve the local scope questions identified in this review.

b_evidence: 在18幅照片全部完成核对并归位前，请勿进行悬挂操作。
findings.observation: A states both completion of checking and placement immediately before venue staff begin hanging. B's corresponding affirmative sentence states only completion of checking; the placement prerequisite occurs in the previous paragraph's prohibition.
findings.potential_difference: If B's affirmative sentence is interpreted independently, checking alone appears to trigger hanging. A's affirmative sentence does not permit that reading. Reading B as a whole retains the explicit prohibition until both checking and placement are complete.
findings.disposition: Keep unresolved as a local dependency-clarity and scope concern. Do not classify the omitted restatement as a confirmed global loss, and do not use the earlier prohibition to dismiss the human report.
findings.smallest_clarification_if_future_edit_is: Express both checking and placement in the affirmative hanging trigger. No text was edited during this review.

b_evidence: 若在核对过程中发现编号不符
findings.observation: B explicitly conditions the mismatch-handling procedure on discovering the mismatch during verification. A's condition is unqualified, but is embedded in a paragraph that begins with verification instructions.
findings.potential_difference: On a broad reading of A, a mismatch noticed during later carrying or hanging still requires quarantine and a list mark. B does not explicitly cover that later-discovery case. On a contextual reading that limits A to verification, the procedures align.
findings.disposition: Keep unresolved as a potentially narrower exception trigger in B. The wording-level qualifier is certain; a substantive difference in intended operational scope is not confirmed by this review.
findings.smallest_clarification_if_future_edit_is: Make the intended discovery-time scope explicit and consistent, after confirming that scope. No text was edited during this review.

findings.observation: A places mismatch handling directly after verification and placement, then gives carrying rules before hanging rules. B gives the no-hanging prerequisite in its first paragraph, the hanging instructions before carrying rules in its second paragraph, and mismatch handling in a separate third paragraph.
findings.potential_difference: This changes when readers encounter exceptions and dependencies. It may affect perceived readability or operational clarity, but this reviewer cannot determine that it caused the human's A preference.
findings.disposition: Record a visible organization change. Do not treat textual order alone as an instruction to carry after hanging or to postpone mismatch handling.

findings.observation: Both passages send mismatched photographs to a pending-confirmation area and require all 18 photographs to be checked and placed before hanging, but neither specifies who resolves a mismatch or returns such a photograph to its position.
findings.potential_difference: This is a shared omission rather than evidence of content being added or lost between A and B.
findings.disposition: Do not attribute this shared procedural gap to either candidate or count it as a preservation defect.

bidirectional_summary.a_to_b: All enumerated content has a counterpart in B, except that the reach of A's unqualified mismatch-discovery trigger outside verification is not explicit in B. The full-passage hanging prerequisite is preserved, but B's affirmative trigger omits its placement restatement.
bidirectional_summary.b_to_a: All enumerated operational content in B is represented in A for the verification case. B's explicit verification-time qualifier is not stated in A's mismatch condition, so exact scope equivalence is not established. No distinct new entity, number, actor duty, permission, or deadline was found.
bidirectional_summary.entity_quantity_actor_checks: The event, 18 framed photographs, two long horizontal photographs, two-person versus one-person carrying rules, venue-staff hanging and handoff roles, two-volunteer recheck roles, entrance-side holding location, existing hooks, and both 11:00 references align.
bidirectional_summary.negation_and_modality_checks: Both retain prohibitions on changing numbers independently, hanging before all photographs are checked and placed, volunteers drilling holes or moving hooks, and directly opening unchecked areas. Both retain required two-person carrying and permitted one-person carrying for the other photographs. No uncertainty claim or citation is present to compare.

conclusion.human_preference_record: The supplied human feedback says A looks easier to read and reports that the contents are not completely identical. This review neither replaces that feedback nor supplies a new human preference or equivalence label.
conclusion.interpretation: There are definite wording and organization differences and two plausible scope ambiguities. This bounded model-assisted review did not confirm an unsupported addition or loss under a full-passage reading. That finding is insufficient to resolve the human's content concern or establish semantic equivalence.
conclusion.resolution_requirement: Only explicit subsequent human resolution can set human_concern_resolved to true; no such resolution has been provided.
